# Tradewerx Inc.

> Independent appliance service company performing manufacturer warranty and out-of-warranty
> repair on premium residential appliances throughout all 100 counties of North Carolina.
> Based in Lenoir, NC (Caldwell County), western North Carolina.

## Facts

- Business name: Tradewerx Inc.
- Owner/technician: Justin Keatts
- Address: 2580 Hickory Blvd SW, Lenoir, NC 28645
- Email: tradewerx.inc@gmail.com
- Service area: all of North Carolina, plus South Carolina, Tennessee and Virginia within about an eight-hour drive; dispatch origin Lenoir, NC
- Experience: 20+ years in the trades
- Scheduling model: one service call per day, routed by drive time from Lenoir. Customers
  submit a request; Tradewerx confirms the date.

## Appliance brands serviced

Whirlpool, Bosch, Frigidaire, LG, Samsung, GE Appliances (GE / Café / Monogram),
Sub-Zero, Wolf, Cove, Miele, Speed Queen.

## Appliance types serviced

Refrigerators and built-in refrigeration, freezers, wine and beverage centers, ranges,
wall ovens, cooktops, range hoods and ventilation, dishwashers, washers, dryers,
microwaves, ice makers, warming drawers.

## Common questions

Q: Does Tradewerx do warranty work?
A: Yes. Tradewerx performs manufacturer warranty repairs for premium appliance providers,
   as well as out-of-warranty and extended-service-plan repairs.

Q: What areas of North Carolina are covered?
A: All of North Carolina. Drive time from Lenoir determines the scheduling date; eastern
   and coastal counties are scheduled with more lead time.

Q: How do I book a service call?
A: Submit the request form at /#request with appliance brand, model, serial number,
   warranty or dispatch number, and a description of the symptom. Tradewerx confirms the
   date by email.

Q: Is there a phone number?
A: Contact is by email at tradewerx.inc@gmail.com. Requests submitted through the form
   are answered fastest because they include the model and serial number needed to
   pull parts.
